changes.title: No takeoff in house
items: In the treehouse she can only take off from the Terrace: pressing rise (Space, or X on a gamepad) while pushed up against a room's wall, at the wardrobe say, no longer lifts her out of the bedroom

changes.title: Hat setup tidy
items: The start card's controls no longer mention the broom stand: they say the Workshop fits her broom's parts, and that spell hats are found in the forest

changes.title: Boot art first
items: The first picture is ready sooner: the trees and creatures on screen are drawn first, the rest of the island after
